scope.reason: Tooling-only regeneration of the existing pinned gem snapshot to add per-stat-set damage multipliers (headers.json setMultipliers). It does not advance the PoB revision and makes no claim about 0.5.5b-0.5.5f. The 0.5.5 notes were read: they contain league, endgame, UI and bug-fix changes, and no skill gem balance changes.

sourceReviews.evidence: All captured inputs are byte-identical to the hashes recorded by the live legacy gem snapshot: 408/408 sources in public/gems/v1/source.json and 503/503 in public/gems/effects-v1/source.json; RePoE keywords.min.json matches public/gems/v1/keywords.json (b9e854ee...). PoB is still pinned to ce566eac (committed 2026-09-10, during the 0.5.5 hotfix window, before 0.5.5b on 2026-09-17).

mechanics.evidence: No game mechanic is added or changed. The new setMultipliers field exposes PoB's existing statSets[n].levels[l].baseMultiplier, which CalcActiveSkill.lua copies over the skill level values. Checked: Boneshatter Shockwave 200% at level 1 and 724% at level 20 match the in-game tooltip range (200-724)%.
